en.text: You shall not see your brother’s ox or his sheep go astray and hide yourself from them. You shall surely bring them again to your brother.

zhSimplified.text: 「你若看见弟兄的牛或羊失迷了路，不可佯为不见，总要把它牵回来交给你的弟兄。

zhTraditional.text: 「你若看見弟兄的牛或羊失迷了路，不可佯為不見，總要把牠牽回來交給你的弟兄。

en.text: If your brother isn’t near to you, or if you don’t know him, then you shall bring it home to your house, and it shall be with you until your brother comes looking for it, and you shall restore it to him.

zhSimplified.text: 你弟兄若离你远，或是你不认识他，就要牵到你家去，留在你那里，等你弟兄来寻找就还给他。

zhTraditional.text: 你弟兄若離你遠，或是你不認識他，就要牽到你家去，留在你那裏，等你弟兄來尋找就還給他。

en.text: So you shall do with his donkey. So you shall do with his garment. So you shall do with every lost thing of your brother’s, which he has lost and you have found. You may not hide yourself.

zhSimplified.text: 你的弟兄无论失落什么，或是驴，或是衣服，你若遇见，都要这样行，不可佯为不见。

zhTraditional.text: 你的弟兄無論失落甚麼，或是驢，或是衣服，你若遇見，都要這樣行，不可佯為不見。

en.text: You shall not see your brother’s donkey or his ox fallen down by the way, and hide yourself from them. You shall surely help him to lift them up again.

zhSimplified.text: 你若看见弟兄的牛或驴跌倒在路上，不可佯为不见，总要帮助他拉起来。

zhTraditional.text: 你若看見弟兄的牛或驢跌倒在路上，不可佯為不見，總要幫助他拉起來。

en.text: A woman shall not wear men’s clothing, neither shall a man put on women’s clothing; for whoever does these things is an abomination to the LORD your God.

zhSimplified.text: 「妇女不可穿戴男子所穿戴的，男子也不可穿妇女的衣服，因为这样行都是耶和华—你 神所憎恶的。

zhTraditional.text: 「婦女不可穿戴男子所穿戴的，男子也不可穿婦女的衣服，因為這樣行都是耶和華－你上帝所憎惡的。

en.text: If you come across a bird’s nest on the way, in any tree or on the ground, with young ones or eggs, and the hen sitting on the young, or on the eggs, you shall not take the hen with the young.

zhSimplified.text: 「你若路上遇见鸟窝，或在树上或在地上，里头有雏或有蛋，母鸟伏在雏上或在蛋上，你不可连母带雏一并取去。

zhTraditional.text: 「你若路上遇見鳥窩，或在樹上或在地上，裏頭有雛或有蛋，母鳥伏在雛上或在蛋上，你不可連母帶雛一併取去。

en.text: You shall surely let the hen go, but the young you may take for yourself, that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days.

zhSimplified.text: 总要放母，只可取雏；这样你就可以享福，日子得以长久。

zhTraditional.text: 總要放母，只可取雛；這樣你就可以享福，日子得以長久。

en.text: When you build a new house, then you shall make a railing around your roof, so that you don’t bring blood on your house if anyone falls from there.

zhSimplified.text: 「你若建造房屋，要在房上的四围安栏杆，免得有人从房上掉下来，流血的罪就归于你家。

zhTraditional.text: 「你若建造房屋，要在房上的四圍安欄杆，免得有人從房上掉下來，流血的罪就歸於你家。

en.text: You shall not sow your vineyard with two kinds of seed, lest all the fruit be defiled, the seed which you have sown, and the increase of the vineyard.

zhSimplified.text: 「不可把两样种子种在你的葡萄园里，免得你撒种所结的和葡萄园的果子都要充公。

zhTraditional.text: 「不可把兩樣種子種在你的葡萄園裏，免得你撒種所結的和葡萄園的果子都要充公。

en.text: You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together.

zhSimplified.text: 不可并用牛、驴耕地。

zhTraditional.text: 不可並用牛、驢耕地。

en.text: You shall not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together.

zhSimplified.text: 不可穿羊毛、细麻两样搀杂料做的衣服。

zhTraditional.text: 不可穿羊毛、細麻兩樣攙雜料做的衣服。

en.text: You shall make yourselves fringes on the four corners of your cloak with which you cover yourself.

zhSimplified.text: 「你要在所披的外衣上四围做 子。」

zhTraditional.text: 「你要在所披的外衣上四圍做繸子。」

en.text: If any man takes a wife, and goes in to her, hates her,

zhSimplified.text: 「人若娶妻，与她同房之后恨恶她，

zhTraditional.text: 「人若娶妻，與她同房之後恨惡她，

en.text: accuses her of shameful things, gives her a bad name, and says, “I took this woman, and when I came near to her, I didn’t find in her the tokens of virginity;”

zhSimplified.text: 信口说她，将丑名加在她身上，说：『我娶了这女子，与她同房，见她没有贞洁的凭据』；

zhTraditional.text: 信口說她，將醜名加在她身上，說：『我娶了這女子，與她同房，見她沒有貞潔的憑據』；

en.text: then the young lady’s father and mother shall take and bring the tokens of the young lady’s virginity to the elders of the city in the gate.

zhSimplified.text: 女子的父母就要把女子贞洁的凭据拿出来，带到本城门长老那里。

zhTraditional.text: 女子的父母就要把女子貞潔的憑據拿出來，帶到本城門長老那裏。

en.text: The young lady’s father shall tell the elders, “I gave my daughter to this man as his wife, and he hates her.

zhSimplified.text: 女子的父亲要对长老说：『我将我的女儿给这人为妻，他恨恶她，

zhTraditional.text: 女子的父親要對長老說：『我將我的女兒給這人為妻，他恨惡她，

en.text: Behold, he has accused her of shameful things, saying, ‘I didn’t find in your daughter the tokens of virginity;’ and yet these are the tokens of my daughter’s virginity.” They shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city.

zhSimplified.text: 信口说她，说：我见你的女儿没有贞洁的凭据；其实这就是我女儿贞洁的凭据。』父母就把那布铺在本城的长老面前。

zhTraditional.text: 信口說她，說：我見你的女兒沒有貞潔的憑據；其實這就是我女兒貞潔的憑據。』父母就把那布鋪在本城的長老面前。

en.text: The elders of that city shall take the man and chastise him.

zhSimplified.text: 本城的长老要拿住那人，惩治他，

zhTraditional.text: 本城的長老要拿住那人，懲治他，

en.text: They shall fine him one hundred shekels of silver, and give them to the father of the young lady, because he has given a bad name to a virgin of Israel. She shall be his wife. He may not put her away all his days.

footnotes.text: 22:19 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 100 shekels is about a kilogram or 2.2 pounds.

zhSimplified.text: 并要罚他一百舍客勒银子，给女子的父亲，因为他将丑名加在以色列的一个处女身上。女子仍作他的妻，终身不可休她。

zhTraditional.text: 並要罰他一百舍客勒銀子，給女子的父親，因為他將醜名加在以色列的一個處女身上。女子仍作他的妻，終身不可休她。

en.text: But if this thing is true, that the tokens of virginity were not found in the young lady,

zhSimplified.text: 但这事若是真的，女子没有贞洁的凭据，

zhTraditional.text: 但這事若是真的，女子沒有貞潔的憑據，

en.text: then they shall bring out the young lady to the door of her father’s house, and the men of her city shall stone her to death with stones, because she has done folly in Israel, to play the prostitute in her father’s house. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

zhSimplified.text: 就要将女子带到她父家的门口，本城的人要用石头将她打死；因为她在父家行了淫乱，在以色列中做了丑事。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。

zhTraditional.text: 就要將女子帶到她父家的門口，本城的人要用石頭將她打死；因為她在父家行了淫亂，在以色列中做了醜事。這樣，就把那惡從你們中間除掉。

en.text: If a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, then they shall both die, the man who lay with the woman and the woman. So you shall remove the evil from Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 「若遇见人与有丈夫的妇人行淫，就要将奸夫淫妇一并治死。这样，就把那恶从以色列中除掉。

zhTraditional.text: 「若遇見人與有丈夫的婦人行淫，就要將姦夫淫婦一併治死。這樣，就把那惡從以色列中除掉。

en.text: If there is a young lady who is a virgin pledged to be married to a husband, and a man finds her in the city, and lies with her,

zhSimplified.text: 「若有处女已经许配丈夫，有人在城里遇见她，与她行淫，

zhTraditional.text: 「若有處女已經許配丈夫，有人在城裏遇見她，與她行淫，

en.text: then you shall bring them both out to the gate of that city, and you shall stone them to death with stones; the lady, because she didn’t cry, being in the city; and the man, because he has humbled his neighbor’s wife. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

zhSimplified.text: 你们就要把这二人带到本城门，用石头打死—女子是因为虽在城里却没有喊叫；男子是因为玷污别人的妻。这样，就把那恶从你们中间除掉。

zhTraditional.text: 你們就要把這二人帶到本城門，用石頭打死－女子是因為雖在城裏卻沒有喊叫；男子是因為玷污別人的妻。這樣，就把那惡從你們中間除掉。

en.text: But if the man finds the lady who is pledged to be married in the field, and the man forces her and lies with her, then only the man who lay with her shall die;

zhSimplified.text: 「若有男子在田野遇见已经许配人的女子，强与她行淫，只要将那男子治死。

zhTraditional.text: 「若有男子在田野遇見已經許配人的女子，強與她行淫，只要將那男子治死。

en.text: but to the lady you shall do nothing. There is in the lady no sin worthy of death; for as when a man rises against his neighbor and kills him, even so is this matter;

zhSimplified.text: 但不可办女子；她本没有该死的罪，这事就类乎人起来攻击邻舍，将他杀了一样。

zhTraditional.text: 但不可辦女子；她本沒有該死的罪，這事就類乎人起來攻擊鄰舍，將他殺了一樣。

en.text: for he found her in the field, the pledged to be married lady cried, and there was no one to save her.

zhSimplified.text: 因为男子是在田野遇见那已经许配人的女子，女子喊叫，并无人救她。

zhTraditional.text: 因為男子是在田野遇見那已經許配人的女子，女子喊叫，並無人救她。

en.text: If a man finds a lady who is a virgin, who is not pledged to be married, grabs her and lies with her, and they are found,

zhSimplified.text: 「若有男子遇见没有许配人的处女，抓住她，与她行淫，被人看见，

zhTraditional.text: 「若有男子遇見沒有許配人的處女，抓住她，與她行淫，被人看見，

en.text: then the man who lay with her shall give to the lady’s father fifty shekels of silver. She shall be his wife, because he has humbled her. He may not put her away all his days.

footnotes.text: 22:29 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces.

zhSimplified.text: 这男子就要拿五十舍客勒银子给女子的父亲；因他玷污了这女子，就要娶她为妻，终身不可休她。

zhTraditional.text: 這男子就要拿五十舍客勒銀子給女子的父親；因他玷污了這女子，就要娶她為妻，終身不可休她。

en.text: A man shall not take his father’s wife, and shall not uncover his father’s skirt.

zhSimplified.text: 「人不可娶继母为妻；不可掀开他父亲的衣襟。」

zhTraditional.text: 「人不可娶繼母為妻；不可掀開他父親的衣襟。」
